identificationModule.briefTitle: A Study of Efgartigimod PH20 SC Given by Prefilled Syringe in Adults With Thyroid Eye Disease.
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase 3, Randomized, Double-Masked, Placebo-Controlled, Multicenter Study to Evaluate the Efficacy, Safety, Tolerability, Pharmacokinetics, Pharmacodynamics, and Immunogenicity of Efgartigimod PH20 SC Administered by Prefilled Syringe in Adult Participants With Thyroid Eye Disease

statusModule.whyStopped: The pre-defined interim analysis concluded that continuing the trials is unlikely to demonstrate the intended efficacy. This decision is not related to safety concerns, and the safety profile of efgartigimod remains unchanged

armGroups.label: Efgartigimod arm
armGroups.description: Participants with active, moderate-to-severe TED receiving Efgartigimod PH20 SC (subcutaneously) via pre-filled syringe (PFS)

armGroups.label: Placebo arm
armGroups.description: Participants with active, moderate-to-severe TED receiving Placebo PH20 SC (subcutaneously) via pre-filled syringe (PFS)

interventions.name: Efgartigimod PH20 SC
interventions.description: Subcutaneous efgartigimod PH20 SC given by prefilled syringe

interventions.name: Placebo PH20 SC
interventions.description: Subcutaneous placebo given by prefilled syringe

primaryOutcomes.measure: Percentage of participants who were proptosis responders
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: At week 24 of the Double-Blinded Treatment Period

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Change in proptosis measurement in the study eye from baseline
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Up to week 24 of the Double-Blinded Treatment Period

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Change in the total Graves' Orbitopathy Quality of Life (GO-QoL) score from baseline
secondaryOutcomes.description: Minimum value: 0 (most negative impact on Quality of Life); Maximum value: 100 (No impact on Quality of Life)
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Up to week 24 of the Double-Blinded Treatment Period

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Percentage of participants with a resolution of diplopia (responders)
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: At week 24 of the Double-Blinded Treatment Period
